main.description: A playable game attached to an external embed. Stored as the `witchsky$game` field on `app.bsky.embed.external#external`, so clients without support render the surrounding link card and the `uri` player page.

kind.description: Runtime required to play the file.

file.description: The playable file. Matches the upstream PDS default blob limit.

width.description: Player width in pixels. Defaults to 4:3 with `height` when absent.

height.description: Player height in pixels. Defaults to 4:3 with `width` when absent.

alt.description: Description of the game for assistive technology.
